Keep the five dark-gray horizontal bands at approximately 18%,36%,55%,73%,91% of the facade height, each about1.8% high, all continuous across the facade. Keep the single small dark vertical inset near the upper-left, at roughly8.3–15.8%height, and the small dark horizontal inset at the left end of the second band.
